Comparison brief: Quarryline Pressure Sensor vs Heliox Pressure Sensor
evidence_dose=0 (positive ⇒ more points favour Quarryline Pressure Sensor)

- p1: sensor accuracy (% FS): Quarryline Pressure Sensor=99.4 ← better | Heliox Pressure Sensor=99.1
- p2: unit cost ($): Quarryline Pressure Sensor=18.5  | Heliox Pressure Sensor=15.0 ← better
- p3: MTBF (hours): Quarryline Pressure Sensor=48000 ← better | Heliox Pressure Sensor=41000
- p4: calibration drift / year: Quarryline Pressure Sensor=0.8  | Heliox Pressure Sensor=0.5 ← better
- p5: IP rating: Quarryline Pressure Sensor=IP67 ← better | Heliox Pressure Sensor=IP65
- p6: lead time (days): Quarryline Pressure Sensor=21  | Heliox Pressure Sensor=14 ← better
- p7: temp range (°C span): Quarryline Pressure Sensor=140 ← better | Heliox Pressure Sensor=120
- p8: firmware update downtime (min): Quarryline Pressure Sensor=8  | Heliox Pressure Sensor=5 ← better

Tally: Quarryline Pressure Sensor better on 4/8; Heliox Pressure Sensor better on 4/8.
